description: Users on slow 3G connections see the login request timing out after 30s instead of retrying. Reproduced on the staging environment with network throttling enabled.
title: Login times out on slow networks

description: On Safari 17, the login button needs two clicks to submit the form. Works fine on Chrome and Firefox.
title: Login button unresponsive on Safari

description: Retrying a failed card payment charges the customer twice. The idempotency key is not propagated on retry, so the payments backend treats it as a new charge.
title: Payments: duplicate charge on retry

description: The checkout end-to-end suite flakes in about 20% of CI runs. Failures cluster around the payment step timing out, suggesting a test-data race rather than a product bug.
title: Checkout E2E tests flaky in CI

description: The search API starts timing out at around 200 requests per second. P99 latency jumps from 180ms to over 8s. Likely a missing index on the products table.
title: Search API timing out under load

description: Password reset emails take up to 15 minutes to arrive during peak hours. The mail queue backs up when marketing campaigns go out.
title: Password reset email delayed

description: Dashboard charts render as blank canvases on Firefox 128. Console shows a WebGL context error. Chrome and Safari are unaffected.
title: Dashboard charts render blank on Firefox

description: CSV exports truncate fields containing emoji or CJK characters. The exporter writes UTF-8 but declares ISO-8859-1 in the header.
title: CSV export truncates unicode characters

description: When the merchant webhook endpoint returns 5xx, the refund webhook is dropped instead of retried with backoff. Refunds then stay stuck in pending.
title: Refund webhook not retried on 5xx

description: Opening a product deep link while logged out crashes the mobile app. Null pointer in the session restore path.
title: Mobile app crashes on deep link
